description_full: Embracer Group AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, develops and publishes PC, console, mobile, VR, and board games for the games market internationally. It operates through, PC/Console Games, Mobile Games, and Entertainment and Services segments. The company also publishes films and comic books, as well as engages in the trading of card games. It distributes games through retailers, physical stores, and digital distributors. The company was formerly known as THQ Nordic AB (publ) and changed its name to Embracer Group AB (publ) in October 2019. Embracer Group AB (publ) was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Karlstad, Sweden.

financial_summary: Embracer Group AB is a small-cap communication services business with a $1.9B market cap on $1.6B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -23% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.
Returns on capital run at 0% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 78% confirm genuine pricing power.
The company is burning through $55M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
Accruals are elevated at -30.9% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.

On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and thin 0.5× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 2.7% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 40% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is, and profit capture is only 0.0× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
